upgrades.name: Limit Break
upgrades.benefit: You can push your body to the absolute limit. Once per day, take an additional action. This causes 1 point of Stability stress.

upgrades.name: Vitals Expert
upgrades.benefit: Your precision attacks bypass basic armor plating completely.

upgrades.name: Frenzied State
upgrades.benefit: When you enter a Frenzied State, you ignore the first instance of damage each round.

upgrades.name: Auto-Stim
upgrades.benefit: You gain an auto-stimulant injector that allows you to instantly recover from minor trauma once per encounter.
